mapper.select: SELECT b.param_code, b.param_val FROM bt_dc_cfg a JOIN bt_dc_param b on a.param_code = b.param_code AND b.status_cd = '00A' WHERE a.status_cd = '00A' AND a.type = #{type}
mapper.update: UPDATE bt_dc_param SET param_val = #{paramVal}, updator_id = #{updatorId}, updated_time = WHERE param_code = #{paramCode} AND status_cd = '00A'
mapper.select: SELECT a.config_id, a.sort, a.rel_param_codes, a.param_group_name, a.cfg_comp_type, a.cfg_comp_props, a.cfg_visible_expr, a.cfg_icon, b.param_code, b.param_val, b.param_name, b.param_desc FROM bt_dc_cfg a LEFT JOIN bt_dc_param b on a.param_code = b.param_code AND b.status_cd = '00A' WHERE a.status_cd = '00A' AND a.type = '0' ORDER BY a.sort
